full.description: This image is a gross specimen photograph of cross-sections of a coronary artery. The sections display significant narrowing of the vascular lumen due to advanced atherosclerotic plaque buildup within the arterial wall. Some of the sections also show evidence of luminal obstruction. The findings are characteristic of severe coronary artery disease.
